ops.name: Fill reservoir M and put it on the dock
ops.where: glovebox or hood, then the tray at the access opening

steps.step: Hand on the reservoir's pull tab (the lid handle carried forward to y -100, z 248..258, in front of the beam tube)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Reservoir M slides out on its dovetail and out through the guard door
steps.detail: free along (0, -125, 0) -> (0, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.85 mm to Metering base (6061, fluted roller over a 100 mm d

steps.step: Fill it in the glovebox (or under argon in a hood): ~80 g per 15 mm build; weigh, close, NFC tag
Slide it back on (the reverse path, checked above); the dock cam opens its shutter

ops.name: Start a build: plate in, door shut, purge, preheat

steps.step: Plate in through the chamber door onto the bayonet (piston at +8 mm)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Close the door and the right draw latch (on the door's right bracket, lever at its front end)
Left draw latch
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Close the guard door (guard lock engages)
Purge: 2-3 vacuum-argon cycles to <= 100 ppm O2 (budgets.py: 2 cycles from 1 mbar, 3 from 10 mbar), then flow
Preheat the plate to 200 C (~15 min ramp on Ø50, README)

ops.name: Liners out, chamber cleaned (alloy change)
ops.interval: each alloy change (~1 h on an Aconity MINI, pain-points)

steps.step: Passivate condensate (slow air bleed, liner thermocouple watched) before vacuuming (pain-points P35)
